Concerns about inadequate reporting of key content in trial protocols345 provided the impetus for the development of the original SPIRIT (Standard Protocol Items: Recommendations for Interventional Trials) statement published in 2013.6 Modelled on the CONSORT (Consolidated Standards of Reporting Trials) statement for reporting the results of randomised trials,7 the international SPIRIT initiative aimed to improve the reporting of trial protocols by producing evidence based recommendations for a minimum set of items to be considered in protocols.
